name: B10-0582/2025 (ECR) – Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament says Belarus is attacking Lithuania by sending balloons that smuggle goods and shut down airports. It backs Lithuania's right to defend its airspace, including shooting down objects from Belarus. It asks the European Union to give Lithuania more money and support, to widen sanctions to cover hybrid attacks, and to work more closely with NATO on airspace security and intelligence.

- The EU is asked to fund Lithuania's defences and widen sanctions; Lithuania and other frontline states are affected.
- The EU and NATO are urged to share intelligence and guard airspace better; member states and NATO are affected.
- The Parliament's position goes to the Council, Commission, member states and NATO; no law changes yet.
